meta.name: verify_ai_scene
meta.note: Read-only structural verification of the generated AI Neural Core .blend

ops.code:
import bpy
s = bpy.context.scene
assert s.render.engine == 'BLENDER_EEVEE', s.render.engine
assert (s.render.resolution_x, s.render.resolution_y, s.render.resolution_percentage) == (1600, 900, 100)
assert s.camera and s.camera.name == 'Cam'
assert len(bpy.data.objects) == 160, len(bpy.data.objects)
nt = s.compositing_node_group
assert nt is not None
gl = next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'CompositorNodeGlare')
assert gl.inputs['Type'].default_value == 'Fog Glow'
assert abs(gl.inputs['Threshold'].default_value - 0.4) < 1e-5
assert abs(gl.inputs['Strength'].default_value - 5.0) < 1e-5
out_n = next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.bl_idname == 'NodeGroupOutput')
assert any(link.from_node == gl and link.to_node == out_n for link in nt.links)
print('AI_SCENE_VERIFY engine=BLENDER_EEVEE resolution=1600x900 objects=160 glare=Fog_Glow threshold=0.4 strength=5.0 output_link=ok')
